CORE MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 30
   C. 15
   D. 44

3. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 49

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 17
   D. 15

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

6. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 22

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 38
   C. 30
   D. 19

8. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

9. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

10. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

11. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 10

13. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

14. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

15. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

16. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 17

17. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

18. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 11
   C. 3
   D. 28

19. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x = 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x < 5

20. Solve for x: x + 4 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 4
   C. 16
   D. 12

21. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

22. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

23. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

24. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 9
   C. 20
   D. 1

25. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 170
   C. 169
   D. 13

26. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

27. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 6
   D. 12.5

28. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 64
   C. 0
   D. 65

29. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 31

30. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 24
